DEFECT_CORRECTED.summary: The parent freezes CE-3's touches as exactly ['db/schema.ts','db/migrations/**','lib/capabilities/**'] and authorizes no governed hosted administrative surface for the node. The CE-3 implementation resolved F-CE3-1 to R-A -- a SECURITY DEFINER read path -- which makes the ACTUAL PostgreSQL OWNER of public.entitlement_effective(uuid,varchar) a load-bearing security fact. An ordinary db/migrations/** unit is forbidden by the baseline unit's own global invariants from issuing ALTER FUNCTION ... OWNER TO. Under the frozen parent there therefore exists NO authorized mechanism by which the evaluator can come to be owned by a non-BYPASSRLS role, and SEC-3, SEC-4, SEC-6 and SEC-12 rest on a premise the parent authorizes nobody to establish.
DEFECT_CORRECTED.why_it_is_a_delta_and_not_an_inference: The parent uses the `touches` field DISCRIMINATINGLY across nine nodes -- db/prepared/** appears for CE-2, CE-5, CE-6, CE-7, CE-8 and CE-9 and is absent for CE-3 and CE-4. That omission is a choice, and the frozen CE-3 node authority says so in HOSTED_DISPOSITION.A_disposition.if_an_implementer_concludes_otherwise: 'A CE-3 implementation that finds it genuinely requires a db/prepared/** capability unit has discovered an AUTHORITY DELTA against the parent MIGRATION_DAG. It must STOP and escalate for a parent amendment. It must NOT infer the authority from the fact that its diff wanted to touch the path.' This amendment IS that escalation, taken by the named route rather than by inference.

C__SECURITY_CONTROLS_ENFORCEABILITY_PREM.clause_amended: SECURITY_CONTROLS -- the ENFORCEABILITY PREMISE of SEC-3, SEC-4, SEC-6 and SEC-12. NOT their semantic meaning.
C__SECURITY_CONTROLS_ENFORCEABILITY_PREM.what_is_expressly_NOT_changed: The control TEXT of all twelve parent controls SEC-1..SEC-12 is unchanged, unrenumbered and unreinterpreted. SEC-3 still says an entitlement does not grant membership. SEC-4 still says membership does not imply entitlement and that the refusal is on the grant, not on the role. SEC-6 still says a cross-organization request fails CLOSED with a failure code rather than an empty result. SEC-12 still says history remains reconstructible from append-only rows, and its 'attacks' clause is untouched. Every control's `enforceable_from` node assignment is unchanged. This amendment adds a PRECONDITION under which four of them are enforceable at all; it does not touch what any of them asserts.
C__SECURITY_CONTROLS_ENFORCEABILITY_PREM.the_premise_made_explicit: Under the R-A resolution, SEC-3, SEC-4, SEC-6 and SEC-12 are enforced THROUGH a SECURITY DEFINER evaluator reading a relation that carries FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. A SECURITY DEFINER function executes with the privileges of its OWNER. If that owner bypasses row-level security, FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is silently inert for every read the evaluator performs, and all four controls degrade from enforced properties to unverified intentions -- with no error, no failing test and no visible symptom.
C__SECURITY_CONTROLS_ENFORCEABILITY_PREM.the_required_property: The CE-3 evaluator's SECURITY DEFINER ACTUAL PostgreSQL owner MUST be a role that does not bypass FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
C__SECURITY_CONTROLS_ENFORCEABILITY_PREM.no_alternative_is_admitted: There is no 'or equivalent role', no 'or a BYPASSRLS posture', no 'or an implementation-defined owner' and no 'policy OR bypass' reading of this clause. A superuser owner fails it. A BYPASSRLS owner fails it. An owner that merely happens to behave correctly on the cluster under test fails it, because rolsuper and rolbypassrls are asserted as pg_roles catalog facts, never inferred from an observed row count.
C__SECURITY_CONTROLS_ENFORCEABILITY_PREM.why_both_flags_and_not_just_one: rolbypassrls alone is insufficient: a superuser bypasses row-level security irrespective of rolbypassrls. Asserting only one flag leaves the other as an open door, so both are frozen.
C__SECURITY_CONTROLS_ENFORCEABILITY_PREM.SEC_12_specific_note: SEC-12 is included because a definer evaluator owned by a bypassing role can answer from rows no policy would have shown it, making the reconstructed history a function of the owner's privilege rather than of the append-only rows. The control's own text is unchanged.

D__REAL_PG_FUTURE_CONTRACT_ORIGIN_CLARIF.base_clause_quoted_verbatim: "cluster": "A DISPOSABLE cluster only, via the repository's disposable-audit path -- NEVER staging, NEVER production, NEVER the canonical local stack."
D__REAL_PG_FUTURE_CONTRACT_ORIGIN_CLARIF.what_is_NOT_changed: The disposable-only rule is PRESERVED ABSOLUTELY. This amendment does not permit a probe against staging, production or the canonical local stack, and does not weaken the rule in any direction. The twelve parent probe ids PG-1..PG-12 are unchanged, unrenumbered and unreassigned, and no parent probe is added or removed by this amendment.
D__REAL_PG_FUTURE_CONTRACT_ORIGIN_CLARIF.the_clarification: A disposable baseline cluster ALONE cannot establish the production/hosted ownership ORIGIN. The disposable cluster can show what the owner IS; it cannot show HOW that owner came to be, because a fixture can set the owner to anything the test wants and the resulting pg_proc row is byte-indistinguishable from one produced by a governed package.
the_node_level_proof_must_establish_BOTH: ACTUAL OWNER -- the pg_proc owner of public.entitlement_effective(uuid,varchar) is uellix_owner, with rolsuper=false and rolbypassrls=false read from pg_roles.

GOVERNED ORIGIN OF THAT OWNER -- the ownership transition was produced by the governed hosted administrative package, applied as the real package, and NOT by a direct ownership statement in the test fixture.
D__REAL_PG_FUTURE_CONTRACT_ORIGIN_CLARIF.why_this_is_a_clarification_and_not_a_ne: The parent's probe list governs the BATCH. The node-local probe family that discharges this obligation is PG-CE3-DEFINER-OWNER, and it is frozen in the CE-3 node amendment, not here. A parent amendment that minted a node-local probe id would be resolving at the wrong altitude.
D__REAL_PG_FUTURE_CONTRACT_ORIGIN_CLARIF.the_falsifier: If the ownership proof would still pass with the governed package absent, it has proven nothing about origin. That falsifier is discharged by mutation control CE3-OWN-M-1 in the companion manifest amendment.

FORWARD_ONLY_CONTRACT.classification: BINDING. Discharges COORDINATOR_CORRECTION_C1 and closes the only unresolved OR left by the opening.
FORWARD_ONLY_CONTRACT.not_implementation_defined: This is NOT left to the implementer. A package whose forward-only disposition is decided at implementation time is one whose reversal semantics nobody adjudicated.

required_future_package_fields.forwardOnlyNoRollbackReason: REQUIRED. Substantive, non-empty, governed rationale. The measured registry mechanism rejects a thin one: db/hosted/forward-only-packages.ts states of its reason field 'Read by the registry tripwire, which asserts it is substantial. A short reason is the failure mode this field exists to make visible: "no rollback" is a decision, and a decision with a one-line justification is a decision nobody made.'

FORWARD_ONLY_CONTRACT.required_rationale_class: Reverting the owner to postgres or to any other BYPASSRLS role recreates the state in which the evaluator executes under a role that bypasses FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, which invalidates R-A and silently un-enforces SEC-3, SEC-4, SEC-6 and SEC-12. A rollback script here would be one whose only effect is to reopen the security defect the package closes.
FORWARD_ONLY_CONTRACT.semantic_class_derivation: This unit is the same semantic class as stella_hosted_0003, which is forward-only because reversal reopens the defect it closes. It is NOT the class of stella_hosted_0008 or stella_0020, both of which ship a _rollback.sql because their effects admit exact governed reversal. The measured registry states the discriminator directly: 'A PRECHAIN UNIT IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY A MEMBER OF THIS LIST ... which is a fact about what those five units DO -- reopening any of them reopens an outage -- and never a property of the channel.'
FORWARD_ONLY_CONTRACT.no_rollback_sql_file_is_authorized: A db/prepared/stella_hosted_0009_rollback.sql is NOT authorized by this amendment, and writing one would be an act against it.
FORWARD_ONLY_CONTRACT.consistency_with_the_measured_registry_i: db/hosted/prechain-ownership.ts states 'Exactly one of `rollbackFile` and `forwardOnlyNoRollbackReason` is non-null' and that forwardOnlyReasonOf 'throws rather than carrying a null into this registry'. rollbackFile=null plus rollbackSha256=null plus a substantive forwardOnlyNoRollbackReason is the exact shape that invariant requires, and is the shape stella_hosted_0003 already carries at BASE_SHA.

FIXTURE_DECONTAMINATION_ORDER.no_transcription_permitted: A duplicated or transcribed copy of the ALTER OWNER statement anywhere in tests/** is equally contaminating and equally forbidden. Removing it from one file and retyping it in another is not decontamination.

OWNER TO in the fixture would be an authority expansion this amendment does not make.

mechanically_forced_test_certifier_hosts.why: The exact hosts are mechanically forced by what the two registries already assert -- the forward-only registry tripwire, the prepared-sql source-of-truth test, the sha256 pins and the per-package failure injections -- and enumerating them from this base would be a guess that a later live-base remeasurement could falsify. A guessed path is not a stronger commitment than an honest deferral.
what_IS_frozen_instead: Any mechanically forced host MUST prove that the package's sourceSha256 matches the real bytes on disk, through the repository's existing sha256OfPreparedSql mechanism rather than through a transcribed constant.
Any mechanically forced host MUST prove the forward-only declaration is internally consistent: rollbackFile null, rollbackSha256 null, forwardOnlyNoRollbackReason substantive and non-empty.
Any mechanically forced host MUST be enumerated by the later opening as EXACT paths, never as a tests/** pattern.
mechanically_forced_test_certifier_hosts.no_broad_tests_authorization: A blanket tests/** authorization is NOT granted by this amendment and MUST NOT be inferred from the fact that a test file will have to change.
